key_insight: The paper argues that AI and quantum information are converging in two directions: AI helps learn, control, and verify quantum systems, while quantum methods reshape learning, model design, and algorithmic thinking.
engineering_relevance: For quantum engineering, the review highlights practical AI tools for measurement-efficient inference, hardware stabilization, workflow automation, and co-design of hybrid quantum-classical systems.
method: Organizes the field into AI-for-QI and QI-for-AI directions.
Covers learning from limited measurements, quantum algorithm discovery, noise control, and quantum-enhanced learning theory.
Connects theory with experimental and hardware-realistic hybrid workflows.
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates a broad survey of recent progress across quantum systems, algorithms, hardware, sensing, networking, and learning theory rather than reporting a single benchmark result.
watch_item: A major implementation concern is that many proposed gains depend on reproducibility, scalability, and realistic hardware constraints in hybrid quantum-classical settings.
paper_title: When AI meets quantum information: A comprehensive review
